english.title: Report an alleged offence involving a person under 18 years of age in breach of s. 44(2)

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Youth Justice and Criminal Evidence Act 1999

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See Section 44(2) for restrictions on reporting alleged offences involving persons under 18.
(ii) See Section 45(3) for direction on restriction on publication of proceedings where it is likely to lead members of the public identifying a person under 18 involved in the proceedings.
(iii) See Section 46(2) for direction on restriction of reporting about certain adult witnesses in criminal proceedings.
(iv) See Section 47 for restrictions on reporting directions.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale

Time limit for prosecutions
six months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
